spans.s: शल् short term (प्रत्याहार ) for the sibilants श्,ष् , स् and ह्; cf. शलं इगुपधादनिटः क्स:
शालच् tad. affix शाल applied to the prefix वि in the sense of the base itself ( स्वार्थे ). See शङ्कटच्.
शालातुरीय name of the great gra- mmarian Panini given to him on account of his being an inhabitant of शलातुर् an old name of the modern Lahore or a name of a place near Lahore; cf. P

शलुवद्भाव treatment as before the elision named श्लु, i. e. reduplica- tion of the preceding root. This शलुवद्भाव is prescribed in the case of the roots भी, ह्री, भृ and हु; cf. भीह्री- भृहुवां श्लुवच्च

सलिङ्ग inclusive of the notion of gender; the word is used in con- nection with the sense of a Prati- padika or a crude base as inclusive of the notion of gender | and number: cf. अर्थग्रहृणस्यैतत् प्रयेाजनं कृत्स्नः पदार्थो यथाभिधीयेत सद्रव्यः सलिङ्गः ससंख्यश्चेति | M. Bh. on P.
